`specs/discovery-log-cleanup.md` no longer describes the discovery stream's removed startup-skip design as if it were current. The spec said that a provider failing construction gets one startup snapshot and no poller, and that any other construction error crashes observe startup; neither is true now. Every enumerated provider gets a poller, construction happens per poll and is retried at the provider's ordinary cadence, and a construction error the poller does not specifically know about is snapshotted rather than being fatal or silent. The consumer-side log-suppression and minds AWS-provider-block sections are unchanged and still accurate.
